race.title: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SEAN OG is in good form and looks the most solid option here with race fitness on his side. The returning Ruby Island took well to chasing last year and is also considered, with Hombre de Guerra appealing as likely to come on from his yard debut. SEAN OG (IRE) RUBY ISLAND HOMBRE DE GUERRA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Ruby Island (7/4), Scarface (7/2), Hombre De Guerra (9/2), Sean Og (9/2), Busty Boy (15/2), The Other Mozzie (14/1)
